text: For every positive dimension and every nonzero real-valued Schwartz f with real Fourier transform, f(x)≤0 for ‖x‖≥1 and f̂(y)≥0 everywhere, bound the supremum of packing volume densities by f(0)/f̂(0) times the volume of the radius-1/2 ball.
